تغابنت (form VI)
# تَغَابَنْتُ (taḡābantu) /ta.ɣaː.ban.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
# تَغَابَنْتَ (taḡābanta) /ta.ɣaː.ban.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
# تَغَابَنْتِ (taḡābanti) /ta.ɣaː.ban.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَغَابَنَ (taḡābana)
# تَغَابَنَتْ (taḡābanat) /ta.ɣaː.ba.nat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
